dailyDigestCard.headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with interactive UI features in ChatGPT
threeBulletTakeaways: Responses may include visual and interactive components chosen for the task.
The release includes learning explanations and small tools users can interact with.
The Oct 7 rollout covered paid plans; Free and Go expansion was scheduled for Oct 8.
